<ParamField body="aria-label" type="string">
  Accessible name describing the reaction. Required unless `aria-labelledby` supplies the name.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="aria-labelledby" type="string">
  ID of the element supplying the accessible name. Can be used instead of `aria-label`.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="count" type="string | number" required>
  Displayed count. Pass a string for localized or abbreviated formatting. Hidden from assistive technology.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="disabled" type="boolean" default="false">
  Disables the native button and prevents activation.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="emoji" type="string" required>
  Emoji displayed beside the count. Hidden from assistive technology.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="loading" type="boolean" default="false">
  Shows a loading indicator, sets `aria-busy`, and prevents activation without changing the supplied pressed state.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="onClick" type="MouseEventHandler&lt;HTMLButtonElement&gt;">
  Native click handler called before `onPressedChange`. Calling `preventDefault()` cancels the change request.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="onPressedChange" type="(pressed: boolean) =&gt; void" required>
  Requests the next pressed state after activation. The caller updates `pressed` and `count`.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="pressed" type="boolean" required>
  Controlled selection state. Sets the selected appearance and `aria-pressed`.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="title" type="string">
  Optional native tooltip text supplied by the caller.
</ParamField>
